item.text: 输入里有几个直接导致问题的点：自定义的 `sticky-header` 不属于内建组件、分类事件用了不兼容的带参绑定、购物车被放在滚动内容内部、视频自动播放没有静音保障且多个实例共用同一 id。接下来会改成内建 `view/scroll-view/image/video` 组合，并保留小程序事件数据集用法。
两个完整文件已经写入指定输出路径。现在只做一次针对输出文件的静态检查，确认没有漏掉购物车层级、吸顶样式、分类数据集事件、图片加载回流和视频失败重试逻辑。

<template>
  <view class="feed-page">
    <scroll-view
      class="feed-scroll"
      scroll-y
      enhanced
      enable-flex
      bindtouchstart="onDragStart"
      bindtouchmove="onDragging"
      bindtouchend="onDragEnd"
      bindtouchcancel="onDragEnd"
    >
      <view class="feed-content">
        <view class="categories" style="top: 0;">
          <text
            wx:for="{{categories}}"
            wx:key="id"
            class="category {{activeCategoryId === item.id ? 'category-active' : ''}}"
            data-category-id="{{item.id}}"
            bindtap="selectCategory"
          >{{item.name}}</text>
        </view>

        <view wx:for="{{products}}" wx:key="id" class="product">
          <image
            class="product-image"
            src="{{item.image}}"
            mode="widthFix"
            lazy-load
            bindload="onImageLoad"
          />
          <product-video wx:if="{{item.video}}" product="{{item}}" />
        </view>
      </view>
    </scroll-view>

    <view class="fixed-cart" bindtap="openCart">购物车 {{cartCount}}</view>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import mpx, { createPage } from '@mpxjs/core'

createPage({
  data: {
    categories: [],
    products: [],
    activeCategoryId: '',
    cartCount: 2,
    loadedImageCount: 0,
    dragging: false
  },
  async onLoad () {
    const { data } = await mpx.request({ url: '/api/feed' })
    const categories = data.categories || []
    this.setData({
      categories,
      products: data.products || [],
      activeCategoryId: categories.length ? categories[0].id : ''
    })
  },
  methods: {
    selectCategory (event) {
      this.setData({ activeCategoryId: event.currentTarget.dataset.categoryId })
    },
    onImageLoad () {
      // Updating reactive state after each load makes the scroll-view recalculate
      // its content extent when widthFix images resolve asynchronously.
      this.setData({ loadedImageCount: this.data.loadedImageCount + 1 })
    },
    onDragStart () {
      this.setData({ dragging: true })
    },
    onDragging () {},
    onDragEnd () {
      this.setData({ dragging: false })
    },
    openCart () {
      mpx.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/cart/index' })
    }
  }
})
</script>

<script type="application/json">
{
  "usingComponents": {
    "product-video": "../../components/product-video"
  }
}
</script>

--- product-video.mpx ---
<template>
  <view class="product-video">
    <video
      id="{{videoId}}"
      class="video"
      src="{{product.video}}"
      autoplay
      muted
      playsinline
      controls
      show-center-play-btn
      bindtap="playVideo"
      bindtimeupdate="onTimeUpdate"
      bindloadedmetadata="onLoadedMetadata"
      binderror="onVideoError"
    />
    <text>{{progress}} / {{duration}}</text>
    <text wx:if="{{videoError}}" class="video-error" bindtap="playVideo">点击重试播放</text>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import mpx, { createComponent } from '@mpxjs/core'

createComponent({
  properties: {
    product: { type: Object, value: () => ({}) }
  },
  data: {
    progress: 0,
    duration: 0,
    videoError: false,
    videoId: ''
  },
  lifetimes: {
    attached () {
      const productId = this.properties.product && this.properties.product.id
      this.setData({ videoId: `product-video-${productId || Date.now()}` })
    }
  },
  methods: {
    onTimeUpdate (event) {
      this.setData({
        progress: event.detail.currentTime,
        duration: event.detail.duration
      })
    },
    onLoadedMetadata (event) {
      this.videoSize = `${event.detail.width}x${event.detail.height}`
      this.setData({ videoError: false, duration: event.detail.duration || this.data.duration })
    },
    playVideo () {
      this.setData({ videoError: false })
      const context = mpx.createVideoContext(this.data.videoId, this)
      if (context && context.play) context.play()
    },
    onVideoError () {
      this.setData({ videoError: true })
    }
  }
})
</script>

<style scoped>
.product-video {
  width: 100%;
}
.video {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
}
.video-error {
  color: #d33;
}
</style>
